comparison.objective: Pose two friction-jointed helping hands so two wire ends cross over a mark.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate articulated friction-held arms by their clip bodies without pulling out the wires.
comparison.success_condition: Released wire ends cross over the target and remain posed; the body supplies no numeric crossing tolerance.
comparison.reason: It tests coupled articulated positioning of two holders. The candidate tests fine socket access, collar adjustment, lock retention, and measured impact behavior.
